up: Retrieve exact IC50 activity values measured in nM for compounds targeting human Indoleamine 2,3-dioxygenase 1. Return the following columns: standard_value, compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, pubmed_id_or_doi (prioritize pubmed_id, fallback to doi), assay_description, target_chembl_id, target_pref_name, organism. Filter by standard_type = 'IC50' and standard_units = 'nM'. Restrict the target to organism = 'Homo sapiens' and pref_name = 'Indoleamine 2,3-dioxygenase 1'. Do not apply a row limit.
sql: SELECT a.standard_value, md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles, COALESCE(CAST(d.pubmed_id AS TEXT), d.doi) AS pubmed_id_or_doi, ass.description AS assay_description, td.chembl_id AS target_chembl_id, td.pref_name AS target_pref_name, td.organism AS organism FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE a.standard_type = 'IC50' AND a.standard_units = 'nM' AND td.pref_name = 'Indoleamine 2,3-dioxygenase 1' AND td.organism = 'Homo sapiens'
